independence.limitation: Executor continuity does not establish independent human or organizational review.

findings.title: Narrow modal loses sequential focus containment
findings.evidence: Frozen B18: modal=true, contained=false, restored=true; forward Tab reaches BODY after the last summary before DIALOG.
findings.requalification: Forward and reverse sequential focus remain inside the modal; Escape, explicit close, backdrop, resize transitions and trigger restoration pass under named engines.

findings.title: Deployment denial is not enforced and the fixture is in the sitemap

findings.requalification: Negative deploy gate blocks unauthorized/unqualified subjects; release output excludes the synthetic route and sitemap entry.

findings.title: 32-bit mathematical-block DOM IDs collide

findings.title: Required frozen-row execution is incomplete

findings.title: Rerun environment is observed, not fully pinned
findings.evidence: Workflows use ubuntu-latest and installed /usr/bin/google-chrome; report records versions but no immutable runner/container image digest.
findings.requalification: Pin or fully identify the runner/browser environment and trigger revalidation on image or browser changes.

findings.title: Organizational independence is not established
findings.evidence: Procedural separation exists, but the executor is continuous across implementation/validation/audit.

findings.title: Declared unsupported qualification surfaces remain unsupported
findings.evidence: No cross-engine, manual screen-reader, production corpus/taxonomy, translation, remote Lean or future-locale runtime qualification.
